name: Technoscience and the City: Advances in Urban Theory
description:
The objective of this course is to examine the current experimental trend in urban public policies and private interventions. Tools and approaches proposed by Science and Technology Studies (STS) are introduced in order to analyze situations where experiments are conducted in the city, and cities are experimented with. Students are asked to work on examples of city experiments that they choose. 

1.	From smart cities to city experiments: introduction and examples
2.	What makes an experiment? Why are scientific experiments political? 
3.	From scientific experiments to other experiments
4.	A vocabulary of experiments for urban studies
5.	Urban laboratories
6.	Workshop: City Cases 
During the final sessions, students present cases of city experiments, which are then discussed collectively. Presentations can use a wide range of material, and refer to any theoretical perspectives introduced in class.
